verdict.rationale: dlt is fundamentally an EL(T) tool moving data from sources to warehouse-style destinations (DuckDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.) and supports custom destinations for 'reverse ETL pipelines' in principle, but the evidence pack shows no named SaaS/CRM/ads/support-tool destinations (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Ads) or documented reverse-ETL connector catalog — the closest is a blog about migrating a HubSpot *source* connector, not writing back to HubSpot. missing for 10: named CRM/ads/support-tool destination connectors, documented reverse-ETL write-back examples/case studies, evidence of activation-specific features (field mapping to SaaS objects, sync cadence for outbound activation), independent confirmation of reverse-ETL use in production.
